disposition_reason: Regulatory opinion: authorized lanthanum carbonate inclusion range in cat feed, additive lanthanum content and impurity results, and post-market adverse event counts; no environmental or food occurrence data.
disposition_locator: Sections 3.1.1 and 3.1.3, pp. 5 to 6; Section 3.2.1.1, p. 7

lod: Panel notes uncertainty on LOQ/LOD of the impurity method (p. 5, footnote 9)

regulatory_or_exposure: EU authorized use of lanthanum carbonate octahydrate (Lantharenol) in cat feed: 1.5 to 7.5 g/kg complete feed (EFSA 2019, Section 3.1.3, p. 6)
Maximum 7,000 mg/kg complete feed stated in Section 3 (p. 5), inconsistent with 7.5 g/kg elsewhere
Additive lanthanum content 43% to 49% specification; 45% measured (p. 5)
non_numeric_findings: Panel confirmed safety for cats at the maximum authorized level.
Consumer and environmental safety out of scope.
No new information changed earlier conclusion of no user risk.
